No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you compare monolithic, cave and structural monuments.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Pancha Rathas site interpretation
  • Selected cave reliefs
  • Shore Temple materiality
  • Pallava patronage reflection

How the time is spent

  1. Pancha Rathas site interpretation 30 min

  2. Selected cave reliefs 60 min

  3. Shore Temple materiality 65 min

  4. Pallava patronage reflection 25 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Compare the monolithic, cave and structural monuments at Mamallapuram.
  • Interpret the Pancha Rathas and selected cave reliefs as Pallava monuments.
  • Describe the materials of the Shore Temple and discuss the role of Pallava patronage.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
